comment: Ravebridge's loot (RavebridgeLoot): what hero mode's enemies drop, kept in the character's Ravebridge bag on this computer and used only on the island. items: a key, its name and description in each language, an icon (a Font Awesome 7 Solid code point), a rarity (common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary), a kind (material, potion) and a value in Ravebridge coins. tables: the first whose match is part of the enemy's loot key wins (a wave enemy's model name, 'boss ' in front for a boss; the island's own enemies their names), coins as [least, most], each drop by its chance (and an amount [least, most]). 'any' adds to every table. shop: what the shopkeeper's cart sells for Ravebridge coins (RavebridgeShop): an item into the bag, a buff for some minutes (damage: more damage dealt, guard: less taken), or an upgrade with a price per level (potions: one more potion carried, roll: half a second off the roll, luck: a tenth more coins from drops); he buys loot at its worth. gear: hero gear for hero mode on Ravebridge (RavebridgeGear); a table's gear is the chance of a piece, gearBoss rolls it with the boss weights.

description.en: Cut from a goblin who will not miss it. Mostly.
description.sv: Skuret från en vätte som inte kommer att sakna det. Nästan.

description.en: Yellow, crooked and still a little sharp.
description.sv: Gul, sned och fortfarande lite vass.

description.en: A goblin's idea of jewellery: a ring of bent wire and a pretty pebble.
description.sv: En vättes idé om smycken: en ring av böjd tråd och en fin sten.

description.en: Never washed, never lost a fight. Smells of victory. And feet.
description.sv: Aldrig tvättad, aldrig förlorat ett slag. Luktar seger. Och fötter.

description.en: Broken off in the last fight he ever lost.
description.sv: Avbrutet i det sista slaget han förlorade.

description.en: It rattled a moment ago.
description.sv: Det skramlade alldeles nyss.

description.en: Still smiling. Nobody knows why.
description.sv: Ler fortfarande. Ingen vet varför.

description.en: The crest of a house that guarded Ravebridge long ago.
description.sv: Vapnet från en ätt som vaktade Ravebridge för länge sedan.

description.en: Cold, wobbly and faintly humming.
description.sv: Kall, darrig och nynnar svagt.

description.en: A sliver of something that wanted to be remembered.
description.sv: En flisa av något som ville bli ihågkommet.

description.en: Warm, heavy and beating very, very slowly.
description.sv: Varm, tung och slår väldigt, väldigt långsamt.

description.en: The cook would know what to do with this.
description.sv: Kocken skulle veta vad man gör med det här.

description.en: Soft, spotted and a little embarrassing to carry.
description.sv: Mjuk, fläckig och lite pinsam att bära på.

description.en: Struck before the bridge had a name. Collectors pay well.
description.sv: Präglat innan bron hade ett namn. Samlare betalar bra.

description.en: The cart finally came. It is a bucket. It holds things.
description.sv: Vagnen kom äntligen. Det är en hink. Den rymmer saker.

description.en: For when you want soup. Or a hat.
description.sv: För när du vill ha soppa. Eller en hatt.

description.en: Q drinks one when the hero's own potions have run out.
description.sv: Q dricker en när hjältens egna drycker har tagit slut.

description.en: A keener edge on every weapon, bow and staff: 15% more damage for 5 minutes.
description.sv: En skarpare egg på varje vapen, båge och stav: 15 % mer skada i 5 minuter.

description.en: Warm, thick and mostly carrots: 15% less damage taken for 5 minutes.
description.sv: Varm, tjock och mest morötter: 15 % mindre skada i 5 minuter.

description.en: Hero gear for Ravebridge, still wrapped. He swears he does not know what is inside.
description.sv: Hjälteutrustning för Ravebridge, fortfarande inslagen. Han svär att han inte vet vad som är i den.

description.en: Room for one more potion in hero mode.
description.sv: Plats för en dryck till i hjälteläget.

description.en: The roll is ready half a second sooner.
description.sv: Rullningen är redo en halv sekund tidigare.

description.en: A tenth more coins from everything that falls.
description.sv: En tiondel mer mynt från allt som faller.

gear.comment: Hero gear (RavebridgeGear): a base (its slot and icon) rolled with affixes when it drops; the rarer, the more and the stronger (rarity: how many affixes, how strong, its worth, how often it rolls; boss: the weights for a boss). An affix's value is between min and max times the rarity's power; suffix names the piece after its strongest affix.
